text_block_list.text:
Surpassing the admired Tiara Umamusume, 
Rhein Kraft brilliantly seized 1st place.

A swirling vortex of excitement whipped
up by the crowd.
Tears welled up in her eyes, 
knowing she had left a spark shining in 
everyone's hearts.

However, she couldn't stop just yet. "I 
will pave the path."

She resolves to compete against other 
Tiara Umamusume and sets her sights on
the 
Queen Elizabeth II Cup as her next target.
